title: Strategy CEO says Bitcoin is a symbol of freedom
summary: Strategy (Nasdaq: MSTR) CEO Phong Le stated on X that Bitcoin represents freedom. He likened the cryptocurrency to the "America of money," explaining that just as the U.S. offered his family freedom and the American Dream, Bitcoin provides monetary freedom to individuals through its network. Le elaborated that Bitcoin applies the principles of the U.S. Constitution to currency by creating a system run by transparent rules rather than individual discretion. He added that it offers hope to those looking to protect their earnings from inflation and to people in nations without the rule of law or economic liberty.

title: UK's new crypto framework draws industry praise, but licensing burdens remain
summary: The U.K. Financial Conduct Authority's (FCA) final framework for digital asset regulation has been met with a positive response from the local industry, CoinDesk reported. The new regulations permit access to global liquidity through overseas exchanges and allow for the circulation of stablecoins issued outside the U.K. However, the rules for licensing overseas branches only state the principle that they must come from a country with an equivalent regulatory framework, without specifying which nations qualify. Industry insiders have pointed out that this lack of predictability and clarity makes it difficult to formulate business plans. Furthermore, the licensing process under the new system is expected to pose a significant burden on businesses. more:

title: NYT: Nearly 1M investors lost an estimated $3.8B on Trump meme coin
summary: The New York Times (NYT) reported that about one million investors in U.S. President Donald Trump's meme coin, TRUMP, have lost money, with total losses estimated at $3.81 billion, citing a report from crypto analytics firm Nansen. The NYT noted that Trump himself profited to the tune of $636 million from the coin, part of at least $2.2 billion in earnings from all his business ventures in 2025. He reportedly promoted the coin on his Truth Social account, urging people to buy, and was able to profit regardless of its price movement. According to Nansen's data, 988,905 buyers—or two out of every three—recorded losses, with their cumulative losses totaling $3.81 billion. One investor lamented that the situation was tantamount to a legal scam. According to CoinMarketCap, TRUMP is currently trading at $1.77, up 0.71%, but remains down approximately 97% from its all-time high of $75.35. more:
